title: Shared tool types (EA-STD-TOOL-001, Appendix B)
description: Paste from here rather than reinventing. A concept defined in this file means the same thing in every tool in the catalogue (TS-INP-04).

decimal.description: A decimal number as a string, to avoid binary floating-point error. Never parse as a float for money arithmetic.

money.description: An amount paired with its currency. Use where a single figure travels without an envelope-level currency.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit UTC offset.

dateOnly.description: A calendar date. The tool's description must state the time zone it is interpreted in.

accountId.description: Internal account identifier. Obtain from brokerage_accounts_list; never construct one, and never show it to a customer.

orderId.description: Order identifier. Obtain from a list tool or from the result of placing an order.

instrumentId.description: Instrument identifier. Required when an option contract must be named precisely.

maskedAccountNumber.description: Customer-facing account number, masked to the last four digits. The only account reference that may be spoken to a customer.

priceBasis.description: How a price or a valuation was sourced. Required alongside any mark (TS-OUT-03).

moneyBasis.description: How a cash or balance figure was computed. Required alongside any balance (TS-OUT-03).

pageSize.description: Maximum items to return. Never called limit, count, or top (TS-INP-15).

cursor.description: Opaque forward continuation token from a previous result. Offset and page-number pagination are prohibited (TS-OUT-06).

detail.description: Verbosity of the result. Preferred over a caller-supplied field list (§13.3.1).

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID identifying one attempt at a state change. Required on every non-idempotent tool (TS-SEC-07).

completeness.description: How much of the matching set this result contains. Mandatory on every collection result (TS-OUT-07).

totalMatching.description: Total items matching the filter, or null when genuinely unknowable.

truncated.description: True when more matched than were returned. Never null.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token, or null on the last page.

narrowingHint.description: How to narrow the query to a complete answer. Preferred over paging (TS-OUT-08).

error.description: The execution-error payload, carried in structuredContent alongside isError true (§11.2).

code.description: The closed taxonomy of §11.3. The only field safe to branch on.

domainCode.description: Registered domain-specific code from Appendix C.

message.description: One or two sentences a person could read, including the numbers that make it concrete.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the identical call could succeed.

retryAfterSeconds.description: How long to wait before retrying, when retryable.

remediation.description: What to do next, in the imperative, naming the argument to change or the tool to call.

details.description: Structured, code-specific facts: the field that failed, the limit that was hit, the maximum permissible value.

traceId.description: Correlation identifier. The only internal identifier permitted to cross out.

resultEnvelope.description: The shape of every invocation result, success or failure (§8.1).

content.description: Presentation blocks. At least one text block, always (TS-OUT-01).

text.description: The compact prose rendering, derived from structuredContent (TS-OUT-02).

name.description: Human-readable name of the referenced resource.

mimeType.description: Media type of the referenced resource.

description.description: What the reference contains, its size, and when the link expires.

structuredContent.description: The authoritative payload. Validates against the descriptor's outputSchema, or carries an 'error' member when isError is true.

isError.description: True when the tool ran and could not do its job. Transport failures never reach the tool (§11.1).
